title: Peruvian Beef Skewers
description: Grilled beef skewers with a Peruvian twist, marinated in a zesty mixture of warm spices.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine aji amarillo peppers, garlic, olive oil, cilantro, salt, black pepper, and lime juice. Blend until smooth.
Thread beef sirloin onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the marinade onto both sides of the beef.
Let the skewers marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Preheat a grill to medium-high heat.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the beef reaches 135°F for medium-rare.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve warm with your choice of sides.
